results.title: Go http client timeout vs context timeout - Stack Overflow
results.snippet: If you want to specialise your deadline/timeout to each request then use context, otherwise if you want 1 timeout for every outbound request then using client timeout is enough. You can also read about it here Specify timeout when tracing HTTP request in Go
